_doc: Levels and what they unlock. XP comes from the walk log: 'xp_per_minute' for every minute focused, plus 'gift_bonus' for the gift a walk brought. Going from level n to n+1 takes xp_base + xp_growth * (n - 1) XP, so level 2 is at 60 XP (an hour), level 3 at 140, and so on; levels carry on past the last reward. Each reward unlocks an animal or a place at that level. Animals and places not listed are unlocked from the start.
